length_in.note: Volvo Cars USA EX30 specifications, 'Vehicle length'. Page title says 2026 EX30 & EX30 Cross Country. Volvo's US media site lists a 2027 EX30 but its model pages returned HTTP 503.

cargo_cu_ft.note: Volvo's '(max)' figures: second row up 12.4, rows folded 27.8. Also listed: 11.2 second row up and 25.4 first row up (to seatback top); frunk 0.2. C/D lists 12.4 / 27.8.

ground_clearance_in.note: Not given on the specifications page; C/D lists NA.

epa_range.note: Labels are EPA's own; they weren't mapped to the maker's trims.

caranddriver.note: Listed among earlier model years on the page titled '2026 Volvo EX30 Review, Pricing, and Specs'.

awd.label: Twin Motor Performance, Cross Country
awd.note: 'Driveline': Single Motor Extended Range 'RWD'; Twin Motor Performance 'AWD'. C/D trims include 'EX30 Twin Motor AWD Cross Country Ultra'.

adapter.note: 'EX30 drivers can now access an additional 29,000+ DC fast chargers across North America with an included NACS Fast Charging Adapter.'

charge_port.note: Volvo doesn't name the port. CCS1 is inferred from the included NACS adapter, which a NACS-port car wouldn't need; Volvo's NACS page (https://www.volvocars.com/us/l/north-american-charging-standard/) also lists EX30 among models that use the 'NACS Fast Charging Adapter'. The EX30 page's '(CCS2)' footnote describes charge-time test conditions, not the US port.

supercharger_access.note: 'EX30 drivers can now access an additional 29,000+ DC fast chargers across North America with an included NACS Fast Charging Adapter.' Volvo's NACS page: 'The Volvo EX90, EX30, EX40, EC40, XC40 Recharge and C40 Recharge can access the network.'

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Volvo among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'can be accessed through an adapter. The adapter has to be provided by your vehicle manufacturer.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: Volvo Cars USA lists the 2026 EX30 with MSRPs, inventory and test-drive links. Volvo's US media home links a 2027 EX30 page (HTTP 503 when fetched).

epa_range.note: As listed by EPA, the Cross Country on 18-inch wheels rates lower than on 19-inch (203 vs 227 mi).

trims.note: Driveline by powertrain; Cross Country is a Twin Motor Performance version.

entries.note: 'Battery capacity' 69.0 kWh; the page data key is 'batteryNominalEnergy', read as gross.
C/D: 'Volvo says that the EX30 can be charged ... at a peak rate of 153 kW'. Volvo's own page states 153 kW as the charging station's power for its 10-80% time.
'Charge time (10-80%) (as fast as)' 28.0 min (AWD). Overview page: 'typical time to charge from 10 to 80 % at a 153kW DC fast charging station (CCS2)'.

Features list on Volvo's US specifications page: 'Heat pump' is 'Included in Plus' and 'Included in Ultra', the only two trims the page lists. The status renders client-side, so it was read in the browser rather than from the saved HTML.

battery.text: High Voltage Battery & System: 8 years 100,000 miles

powertrain.text: No separate powertrain warranty listed for fully electric models; New Vehicle Limited Warranty (U.S.) 4 years/50,000 miles

warranty.note: Volvo's MY2026 Fully Electric Models warranty manual, which covers EX30, EX40 and EC40.

highway_tests.note: C/D 75-mph highway range test. Temperature not stated.

caranddriver.note: C/D rating in the page's review data; page titled '2026 Volvo EX30 Review, Pricing, and Specs'.

notes.text: Peak DC rate is Car and Driver's report of Volvo's figure.
